metadata.scope: 115 corpus TXT/XML document pairs; dictionaries, run copies and external source repositories excluded
metadata.counting: One record per first phrase boundary below the nearest word-category ancestor; nested phrases beneath that boundary are not counted again unless another word ancestor intervenes
metadata.matching: Literal documented word base or base-hyphen suffix, and NP/PP/IP/CP/CONJP base or suffix; CP-N excluded because its classification is explicitly unresolved. Unclassified wrappers are traversed, not assigned a meaning.
metadata.locations: TXT/XML line numbers are 1-based. xml_child_address starts with zero-based block ordinal, then zero-based actual child positions within that block, including metadata children. Line references apply to this snapshot. TXT context ranges may include noncontiguous prefix matches and ignore distinction labels when selecting context; exact XML addresses and preserved annotation_path distinguish individual cases.
metadata.forms: Form yields are concatenated locator strings, not approved word segmentation. Multipart forms count once; annotations and markers are not removed from the source.
